blurb: Colombo Lodge is an Italian cultural society and event venue located in Kamloops, BC. Our facility offers a unique and elegant space for weddings, receptions, corporate events, fundraisers, conferences, and other special occasions. Our team is dedicated to providing personalized service and ensuring your event is a memorable experience.
